cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Efficiency Win
cards.instruction: Celebrate each inconvenience as proof that a faster, cheaper, or smarter routine can now be invented.

mechanism: A approves replacing paid exercise with unavoidable stair use, turning each inconvenience into a supposedly more efficient routine under personal authority.
confusable: D20 reinterprets setbacks positively; D44 must invent a faster, cheaper or smarter routine, not just celebrate discomfort.
comparison: Broken-lift exercise replaces memberships, while the other alternative redesigns serving food to eliminate washing and ingredients.
seedUse: Use D44-a canonical stair and shopping ideas only as creative context; preserve its protected single exception without reapproval.
